steps.sql: DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j RETURNING int) AS v;

DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING) AS v;

DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING integer) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING double precision) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING decimal) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING varchar(max)) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING varchar(0)) AS v;
DECLARE @j json=N'{"n":12}'; SELECT JSON_VALUE(@j,'$.n' RETURNING decimal(39,2)) AS v;
